author: Pallas, 1769
status: 길잃은새, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만 · 기록을 검토하는 중
habitat: 해안, 거친 땅의 움푹한 곳이나 맨땅(번식지)
summary: 우리나라에서는 예전에 관찰된 기록만 있는 길잃은새이다. 주로 해안에 살며, 거친 땅의 움푹한 곳이나 맨땅에 알을 1개만 낳아 암수가 번갈아 품는다. 알은 엷은 황갈색 기가 도는 회백색 바탕에 작은 어두운 갈색 얼룩이 있으나, 가끔 얼룩 없이 암갈색이나 흰색인 것도 있다. 일본과 태평양 북부 베링해에 분포한다.
young: 어린새는 온몸이 짙은 초콜릿빛 갈색이며, 자라면서 얼굴과 아랫면부터 차츰 흰 부분이 넓어져 어른 깃이 되기까지 여러 해가 걸린다.

art.subject: Short-tailed Albatross (Phoebastria albatrus), adult: head, neck and body white, with a golden-yellow wash over the crown, nape and hindneck; back white. Upperwing with black primaries and secondaries and a large white patch on the inner wing coverts joining the white back; tail white with a black tip. Underwing white with narrow black margins. Huge bright pink bill with a pale bluish hooked tip and a thin dark line around its base; dark eye; pale legs and webbed feet.
art.pose: gliding low over the sea on long wings
art.scene: open sea off the Korean coast; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing: white body and head with a yellow-washed crown and nape, black flight feathers folded along the side, huge pink bill with a pale bluish hooked tip, pale webbed feet
adult in flight, seen from above: white back joining a large white patch on the inner wing coverts, black primaries and secondaries, white tail with a black tip, pink bill
art.build: Very large seabird, 90cm long, far bigger than any gull, with extremely long, narrow, stiff wings; heavy body, thick neck and rounded head. Bill massive, deep and long, about as long as the head, ending in a strong hooked tip, with tubular nostrils along the sides. Legs short and set far back, feet webbed. Tail short. In flight it glides and banks low over the waves on long, straight, almost motionless wings.
avoid: Do not paint a dark brown back and upperwing (Laysan Albatross) or an all-dark body (Black-footed Albatross and young birds).
Do not give it a small yellow gull bill or short gull wings; the bill is massive and pink with a hooked tip.
Do not paint the head pure white; adults have a golden-yellow wash on the crown and nape.
